Back in high school, I had a pretty close-knit group of friends. They were really relaxed guys to hang out with and go do various activities. We were all on the same sports teams, enjoyed the same video games and played online with each other, and listened to the same music (with an exception to myself, but that can be a different story).

There was always a hangout place we could go to, as one of our friends had a very nicely furnished loft. His parents were really unobtrusive and kinda stayed out of our hair while we were up there, so it was a great place for everyone to hang out. Throwing card fights, gaming parties, wrestling (A few of us were on the wrestling team), and a lot of other typical high-school-guy things. The summer before my junior year we were all hanging out in the loft, and being a hot midwestern summer day, we were wearing cut off shirts and baggy basketball shorts while playing UFC on my buddy's PS3.

As I'm sitting on the couch with my shorts riding up, my friend (We'll call him Mike1) glances at me and catches a glimpse of my man-cameltoe and can clearly see that one of my testicles is significantly larger than the other.

Now, Mike1 isn't a bad guy. I actually asked him if he'd be my best man,but he couldn't attend because of school in a different state. It was just the company we were in when he brought it up that was less than optimal.

In our group of friends there are two mikes. Mike1 who is a very smart, very funny guy and could get just about any girl he played his cards with; and Mike2 who was a socially awkward show-off who always had to try and prove himself. Mike2 and I had a few falling-outs and a fist fight (that could also be another story, but I'll try and keep this one short), but we ended up cooling everything down between us and becoming good friends a few years down the road. Turns out it was hardly even our fault that we didn't get along.

That all falls on Ian.

Now, Ian and I have since gotten along and we're pretty good friends now, but I used to hold a lot of contempt towards him. Partially I was jealous because he could do just about anything he decided he felt like doing and do it well, but also because he was one of the worst friends I ever had.

Ian was a real pot-stirrer. He would take a weakness of someone's and really turn it against them. When Mike1 asked me what was wrong with my balls, Ian immediately jumped to thinking it was Testicular Cancer and proceeding to call me TC. At the time it was pretty funny but after a few weeks of it, I really started to get worried. One was about twice the size of the other, and oddly shaped. I decided to do some googling and went to a doctor thinking it was a Vericocele.

Turns out it was an Inguinal Hernia instead, but I was worried nonetheless that I could have cancer and be denied entry to the military. Ian made sure I felt awfully crappy about my situation by using it for his cheap laughs each time he saw me for a couple of months. After the surgery it all died down though. And now four years later, we're pretty good friends again.
